name: Button
summary: Spring-pressed React motion button with base, stateful, magnetic and metallic variants, installable via the shadcn registry.
description: A motion button component for React and Next.js from beUI. Variants: a base button with press scale, hover lift, sizes (sm, md, lg, icon) and outline, ghost, primary and secondary styles; a stateful button that cycles idle → loading → success/error with blur-swap slots; a magnetic variant with cursor-attracted pull; and a metallic variant with a chrome rim and a traveling reflection. Copy the source or install it with bunx shadcn add @beui/button-*.
contains: 4 button variants: base, stateful, magnetic, metallic
base: pressScale 0.93, sizes sm/md/lg/icon, outline/ghost/primary/secondary, optional ripple
stateful: idle, loading, success, error states with blur-swap slots and morphing width
metallic: chrome rim with a traveling reflection, paused prop to stop it
source files: base.tsx, index.tsx, magnetic.tsx, stateful.tsx, metallic.tsx
